examples.scenario: Run the game-account administration bot with app users, account workflows and a persistent composer keyboard
examples.minimum_profile: Mattermost 12.0.2 with Blocks, forms.file and the mattergram-menu plugin
permissions: bot can create and edit posts
bot can read submitted import files
bot can create direct channels for configured pushes
assertions: the keyboard exposes only Overview, Accounts and authorized Users entries
secondary operations remain contextual actions inside the editable post
account cards never render password or active cookie values
filters, sorting and pagination are backend-driven and user-scoped
role checks are enforced by declarative routing metadata
